translation.title: Salicylic Acid Acne Solution
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for the treatment of acne.
translation.usage: Use it twice a day, in the morning and in the evening.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it or have had a hypersensitivity reaction to it, or if you have diabetes or a blood circulation disorder. Do not apply it around the eyes, on mucous membranes, or on areas with infection, inflammation, redness or irritation. Use it with particular care if you have had allergic reactions to medicines or cosmetics, if you have kidney failure, or if you are hypersensitive to propylene glycol. This medicine is for external use only - follow the directed dose and schedule exactly. If you have festering (purulent) dermatitis, weeping (oozing) skin or erosion (raw skin), treat that condition first before applying this medicine. If your symptoms do not improve after repeated use, stop use and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Take care that it does not touch the eyes, nose, mouth or other mucous membranes; if it accidentally gets into the eyes, rinse completely with plenty of water and follow a doctor's instructions. If this medicine is accidentally swallowed, consult a doctor or pharmacist. For children, use it under the supervision of a guardian. Adverse reactions such as rash, redness, erythema (red patches), itching, or a local irritation reaction where the medicine touches healthy skin may occur; if they do, stop use immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Store at room temperature away from moisture and light, keep out of reach of children, keep away from fire, and keep the cap tightly closed when not in use.
